headline: Pakistan Posts First Current Account Surplus of FY27 in October
summary: Pakistan reported a current account surplus of $39 million in October 2026, supported by a lower import bill and strong growth in workers' remittances.
why: Current account balances are crucial indicators of external economic stability and foreign exchange reserve management.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: A return to a current account surplus eases pressure on external reserves and the local currency.
